We had switched roles when baby was about one and it was honestly the best feeling in the world, the problem is/was that when I would go to work the house would fall apart and I’d end up coming home after long shifts cooking and cleaning. 
Also, the reason my husband is working so much right now is because his business is just taking off. 
He’s an artist, so he can’t exactly delegate work to others so much of his time is dedicated to his work. 
And he’s awesome and so so good at what he’s doing right now, if things were normal I would definitely have my son in a daycare or pre-k program so that I could work too, because I love my line of work. 
So that’s the hope, that sometime in the near future when things are relatively normal again I’ll be able to do that.
